title: valeriana chenopodiifolia
intro: Valeriana chenopodiifolia, commonly known as a species of valerian, is a flowering plant in the family Valerianaceae. It is native to New Zealand and is known for its medicinal properties, providing relief from anxiety, insomnia, and other stress-related conditions. The health benefits of Valeriana chenopodiifolia include its sedative and anxiolytic effects, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions of promoting relaxation and reducing restlessness. The bioactive constituents of Valeriana chenopodiifolia include valepotriates, valerenic acid, and isovalerenic acid, which contribute to its sedative and anxiolytic properties.
